datasets.name: Landslide4Sense (L4S) 2022 benchmark dataset
datasets.verbatim: The landslide4sense (L4S) 2022 competition has provided the first globally distributed landslide benchmark data set... Landslide4Sense (L4S) developed a medium-resolution, multi-spectral, multi-source landslide benchmark dataset for machine learning algorithms, with high-accuracy landslide image requirements.

methods.name: SwAV integrated with an auto-encoder
methods.summary: A self-supervised learning framework that integrates the SwAV (Swapping Assignments between multiple Views) algorithm within an auto-encoder architecture. It uses a pre-trained ResNet-18 encoder (trained via SwAV on unlabeled data) and a U-Net decoder fine-tuned on a small subset (1% or 10%) of labeled landslide data to produce pixel-wise landslide probability maps.
methods.verbatim: Therefore, this study introduces a novel approach by integrating SwAV within an auto-encoder framework for landslide detection... This study implements supervised and unsupervised processes using Python and PyTorch on an Ubuntu server with 4 NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPUs.

reproducibility_assessment: The Landslide4Sense benchmark dataset is mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for the SwAV auto-encoder framework lacks a repository or persistent link.
